title: File access built from input (vba) — review required
description: A vba file operation builds its path from input: Opens+[a-zA-Z][w$]*s+For. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via an allowlist of names.
remediation: Confine with an allowlist of names or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.

tests.line: # audit: Open fname For Input present
